svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer · Text tab · Add Crafted Text · 1000×700
svg.desc:
Mirrors App/Overlay/CraftedTextSheet.swift raised from App/Overlay/OverlayEditingPanel.swift's craftButton, with App/AI/CraftedTextService.swift behind it (the model plumbing only since 2026-09-04 — the prompt and the parser live in LetsLapseKit/CraftedTextPrompt.swift, which `lapse craft` drives headless so CI can test the generative path with no model, device or window) — NEW 2026-09-04 from the Claude Design handoff "Photo viewer text transitions" TURN 3 ("Add Crafted Text + followers move together"). The sheet is 480 wide, radius 14, on a 38% black scrim over the whole window; the Text tab behind it is the state photo-viewer.text.svg draws. STAGED: LL_EDITOR=<interval project> LL_RAIL=text LL_TEXT=story,craft (the `craft` part raises this sheet over the staged story; LL_TEXT=crafted instead stages the RESULT — the brief run through the splitter, layout and insert — which is what the two crafted layers in the iOS mirror are).
FOUR STATES, and which one it opens in is decided by whether a LANGUAGE model is installed. PROMPT (drawn here): title "What would you like to communicate?" 19/700 −0.2; the brief field (88 tall, 1px black-22% border, radius 8, 14pt, placeholder "Type the words, or describe what you need…"); two mode cards side by side (radius 10, #F2F2F7, and when chosen accent-6% under a 1pt accent-55% ring) — "Final copy · Split into lines and laid out." and "Needs work · Describe it; pick from a few candidates." each with a 16pt radio (5pt accent ring when on, 1.5pt #C7C7CC off); then the footer: "On device · <model name>" 11pt #8A8A8E and the Send pill (32pt, accent, 13/600 on-accent, 40% while the brief is empty). THINKING: the same card with the title replaced by "Splitting into lines…" / "Finding a few directions…" / "Finding a few more…", the brief quoted in italic 13pt secondary, an INDETERMINATE linear progress bar tinted accent, and the footnote "<model> · on device · nothing leaves this Mac". The design mocked a determinate bar because its model was a 1.3 s timer; a real generation has no honest progress to report, so the bar does not pretend to. CANDIDATES: "Pick a direction" + "Tap one to lay it out as final copy.", up to three 10-radius #F2F2F7 rows (14pt copy, accent chevron.right) and a footer of two accent links — "‹ Edit brief" and "More like these"; a "More like these" that comes back empty keeps what was already on offer. SIMPLE (no language model): "Add text" + "One line per layer. Lines stack top to bottom and follow each other in time.", a 96-tall field, the notice row (accent-8%, radius 10: ✦ "Enable AI to enhance this experience" · "Settings › AI Models ›" 11.5/600 accent) and the Add pill reading "Add line" / "Add N lines".
WHAT COUNTS AS AVAILABLE: only an MLX entry. The catalogue also holds the built-in Vision tagger and a Core ML segmentation model, and neither can write a word — selecting one of those opens the SIMPLE state, not a prompt that would fall back silently (found on the 16 Pro simulator 2026-09-04, where the active model was Vision and the sheet offered to think).
WHAT COMES BACK, AND WHAT IS DONE WITH IT: the model answers with parts — {copy, emphasis[], priority} — and everything visual is LetsLapseKit/CraftedText.swift's, so an odd answer produces plainer copy rather than a broken frame. Priority 1 is the payoff line: 0.13 of the long edge, display face, amber #FFB340 with white emphasis, Element · Pop. 2–3 are 0.075/0.06, a hand face, white with lemon #F3E37C emphasis, Word · Slide. 4–5 are 0.05/0.045, sans, Element · Fade. The FACES are roles, not names: the design's Chango / Amatic SC / Quicksand were Google stand-ins for IMPORTED fonts (its own README says not to bundle them), so display takes the project's first imported face, hand the second (or the first), and the quiet lines stay in the system face. Each line is then shrunk until it fits 84% of the frame width — measured through Core Text in the face that will draw it (TextOverlayRasterizer.emWidth) — and a line the fit shrank below a less important one pulls that one down to 80% of itself, so the hierarchy survives the fit. The lines stack, centred as a block on 0.56 of the frame height at 1.3× line boxes, each FOLLOWS the one above it (gap 0) and their reveal band finishes just before the playhead, so the copy is already up when the sheet closes. Emphasis stretches become their own runs (matched case-insensitively, in the copy's order; an emphasis the copy does not contain is ignored). Labels are "Crafted · line N", which is what the layer rows, the lane gutters and the After-layer picker then call them. Toast: "N lines added · each follows the one above".
NOTHING LEAVES THE DEVICE: this is the same on-device Gemma 4 E2B the Scenes work loads (SceneAnalyser.compose — text in, text out, sharing the resident weights rather than loading a second container), and the sheet says so on both the prompt and the thinking states.

g.text: River and bridge sunset jpeg i12
What would you like to communicate?
Type the words, or describe what you need…
Split into lines and laid out.
THINKING — "Splitting into lines…", the brief quoted, an indeterminate
accent bar, "Gemma 4 E2B · on device · nothing leaves this Mac".
CANDIDATES — "Pick a direction", three #F2F2F7 rows with accent ›,
then "‹ Edit brief" and "More like these".
SIMPLE (no language model) — "Add text", one line per layer, the
accent-8% "Enable AI…" notice, and "Add N lines".

svg.text: Add Crafted Text · prompt state · 480pt sheet on a 38% scrim
Turn 3 of the "Photo viewer text transitions" handoff. Parts in, typography by CraftedTextLayout; the model is on-device and optional.
